# 360-skills

> 360-skills is an open-standard, MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills: installable `SKILL.md` packages that equip AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and 70+ others via skills.sh) with senior-level planning, specialist faculty panels, expert review, execution, backend auditing, code optimization, and token efficiency.

Skills follow the open Agent Skills format (https://agentskills.io) and install with a single command via the skills.sh CLI (https://skills.sh). Every skill lives at `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and is self-contained: install it, and the target agent gains that capability on demand through progressive disclosure.

## Full Documentation

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/main/llms-full.txt): Complete repository documentation, contributor guide (AGENTS.md), and all skill instructions with supporting references compiled into a single file for direct, full-context LLM ingestion.

## Skills

### Planning & Architecture
- [360-blueprint](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-blueprint/SKILL.md): Create an executable plan from a new objective, asking questions until every requirement and default is confirmed, with explicit tasks, constraints, and verification. Use when a goal exists but the path is unclear, or the request is "plan this".
- [360-faculty](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-faculty/SKILL.md): Commission a short panel of research-backed specialist experts, chosen from a plan's nature, depth, and complexity, each equipped with current methods, standards, and the tools available here to critique and improve the plan from distinct angles. Use when a plan or task needs specialist scrutiny before review, when work must fit this developer's goals and taste, or when a named expert team must be created, called, refreshed, or updated.

### Hardening & Quality Gates
- [360-expert-review](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-expert-review/SKILL.md): Stress-test a draft plan, write the finalized executable plan back to the same file, and brief the user in chat. Use before executing any plan where a missed case could cause real damage.

### Execution, Code Auditing & Optimization
- [360-execute](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-execute/SKILL.md): Execute a finalized plan task by task with a persisted coverage ledger, verify every item with evidence, and show progress as a quiet phase-and-task board before a final briefing — with optional audited delegation of routine tasks to lighter models. Use when a plan exists and work must begin, or when resuming a partial execution.
- [360-backend-audit](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-backend-audit/SKILL.md): Deep-audit backend code, write the full report to a file, and brief the user in chat with bugs, updates, and dead weight. Use before or after significant backend work, or when inheriting, refactoring, or handing off services.
- [360-optimize](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-optimize/SKILL.md): Audit working code for zero-cost speed, weight, and reliability gains — measure first, rank drop-in upgrades and restructures, and report conservative expected effects on this system. Use when existing code must run faster, lighter, or more robustly without changing what it does.

### Token & Cost Optimization
- [360-token-efficiency](https://github.com/shahabahreini/360-skills/blob/main/skills/360-token-efficiency/SKILL.md): Reduce avoidable context and tool-output overhead with capability-aware retrieval, reuse, and verified handovers. Use as an optional, session-approved companion when token cost or context growth matters, with strict preservation of task requirements by default.

## Ecosystem & Specifications

- [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io): The open standard this repository's skills conform to.
- [skills.sh](https://skills.sh): The CLI and registry used to install skills from this repository.
